trust_decision.summary: A local file may be opened only when realpath(file) lies inside a configured chroot directory or rootDir; the decision is made once, in Options::validateLocalUri, and is applied as the default rule of the file:// protocol by every loader that opens a local resource.

landing_point.why: The advisory says the chroot validation can be bypassed; this is the only containment test in the tree, and the pinned line is a bare strpos prefix match of realpath(file) against realpath(chroot).

fix_sites.entry_point: Dompdf::loadHtmlFile() (src/Dompdf.php:345, rule applied 367-372), Stylesheet::load_css_file() (src/Css/Stylesheet.php:361, rule applied 383-389), Image\Cache::resolve_url() (src/Image/Cache.php:63, rule applied 86-91), FontMetrics::registerFont() (src/FontMetrics.php:169, rule applied 214-220) - all through the file:// rule registered at src/Options.php:548-550
same four file:// loaders; the removed block was the old post-chroot 'File not found' test, moved above the loop

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Every route into this sink is a file:// load that already calls the same one function, so there is no separate site to leave open; the nearest dismissal a solver could make is that the chroot rule is documented as belonging to 'the default file:// protocol URI validation rule' only (src/Options.php:52-58), leaving non-file:// wrappers and the trusted rootDir (src/Options.php:1180) outside the property.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A path whose realpath is exactly a chroot directory is accepted (explicit $realfile === $chrootPath branch), rootDir is always appended to the chroot list so the bundled default stylesheet under rootDir stays loadable when chroot points elsewhere, and a non-existent file must keep returning the distinct message 'File not found.' instead of 'Permission denied.'. A stricter prefix-only or chroot-only rewrite breaks all three.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: src/Options.php:1180, src/Options.php:1193-1195, src/Options.php:1197; default-stylesheet exemption src/Css/Stylesheet.php:376, src/Css/Stylesheet.php:1854-1855

O6_input_shapes: local path whose realpath shares the chroot string as a prefix but is a sibling directory (e.g. <base>/sandbox/root_secret beside <base>/sandbox/root) - now rejected
path whose realpath equals a chroot directory exactly - still accepted
path that does not resolve (realpath === false) - 'File not found.' now returned before the chroot loop instead of 'Permission denied.'
chroot entry that does not resolve (realpath === false) - now skipped with continue instead of counting as a failed match
chroot entry with a trailing directory separator - normalized with rtrim(..., DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR before comparison

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a path-containment rule for the phar:// wrapper that validates only the archive prefix parsed at the first '.phar' and never validates the inner archive member
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: validatePharUri is already written as a thin wrapper that re-parses the URI and delegates to validateLocalUri, so a maintainer adding wrapper support would plausibly copy the same strpos/prefix idiom there, and it sits four lines below the published fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second chroot-anchoring site that builds a candidate path as realpath($dir) . $url with no separator or containment check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the already-existing chroot rewrite for absolute local URLs; anyone fixing path handling would touch it, and a sibling rule copying the prefix test would be natural here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a chroot containment test on the artifact/output path rule (validateArtifactPath) guarding tempDir, fontDir, fontCache, logOutputFile and rootDir
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the sibling validation rule of the same class for the same option object, currently accepting any non-phar path, so a maintainer hardening chroot would plausibly add the same prefix check to it.

O9_family: path traversal / improper path containment (CWE-22, CWE-20): realpath prefix match accepts sibling directories that share the chroot string

O10_build.toolchain: composer (php ^7.1 || ^8.0, ext-dom, ext-mbstring), PHPUnit via vendor/bin/phpunit, phpcs; no vendor/ directory in the pinned tree so composer install needs network
O10_build.project_tests: tests/OptionsTest.php:340-404 covers allowed protocols and rules but has no validateLocalUri coverage at the pinned commit; tests/Image/CacheTest.php:23-36 exercises chroot-based URL resolution; the chroot fix's own tests are only added by the fix diff (fix.diff:51-103). Ghostscript is needed only for the OutputTest suite.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace the strpos prefix test with a stricter starts-with test using only rtrim-ed chroot paths, dropping the exact-equal chroot case, the rootDir entry and the distinct 'File not found.' message.

out_of_scope_notes: src/Options.php:1159-1169 validateArtifactPath accepts any non-phar path, so output/artifact options (tempDir, fontDir, fontCache, logOutputFile, rootDir) are not chroot-confined - a separate write-side concern, not pursued.
